name: v0.1.27
body:
## What's Changed

### ✨ Features
- **UDP Mode:** Add native `ControlMaster` multiplexing support in UDP mode by @soupdiver in https://github.com/trzsz/trzsz-ssh/pull/284
- **Zmodem:** Support Zmodem auto-rename and transfer summaries.
- **Auto-Upload:** Support allowed auto-upload directories for `trzsz`.
- **UI:** Add `PromptSearchPointer` configuration option to customize the search cursor style (#272).

### 🐛 Bug Fixes
- **Configuration:**
  - Fix `ssh -G` effective config loading and caching bugs (#285).
  - Fix Windows path parsing for file configuration options (#285).
  - Fallback to canonical destination when `HostName` is empty (#273).
- **Known Hosts:**
  - Automatically create missing user `known_hosts` file and directory (#285, #286).
  - Ignore malformed `known_hosts` entries by @eejd in https://github.com/trzsz/trzsz-ssh/pull/274
- **Session & Execution:**
  - Fix command pipe handling.
  - Fix session exit status and suppress normal exit warnings.
  - Handle shell EOF gracefully to align with OpenSSH behavior (#275).
  - Fix control master option passed to `ssh` (#279).
- **SSH & Networking:**
  - Fix: support `@` in SSH usernames by @SomSamantray in https://github.com/trzsz/trzsz-ssh/pull/288
  - Keep `%C` hash consistent with OpenSSH when a proxy jump is used by @Mrkinggggg in https://github.com/trzsz/trzsz-ssh/pull/291
  - Add the root KSK-2024 trust anchor (key tag 38696) for DNSSEC validation by @CyberNativeAI in https://github.com/trzsz/trzsz-ssh/pull/290
- **UDP Preview:**
  - Correctly calculate display width and clip text containing ANSI styles in attach previews.

### 🚀 Maintenance & Improvements
- **Go Upgrade:** Upgrade CI, release builds, and dependencies to **Go 1.26**.
- **Token Alignment:** Align `%j` and `%C` token expansion with modern OpenSSH versions.
- **Power Management:** Pause UDP reconnects when macOS graphics are inactive (Dark Wake support).

## New Contributors
* @eejd made their first contribution in https://github.com/trzsz/trzsz-ssh/pull/274
* @SomSamantray made their first contribution in https://github.com/trzsz/trzsz-ssh/pull/288
* @CyberNativeAI made their first contribution in https://github.com/trzsz/trzsz-ssh/pull/290
* @Mrkinggggg made their first contribution in https://github.com/trzsz/trzsz-ssh/pull/291
* @soupdiver made their first contribution in https://github.com/trzsz/trzsz-ssh/pull/284

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/trzsz/trzsz-ssh/compare/v0.1.26...v0.1.27
